purpose: Recompute every external Main II baseline by applying its frozen horizon-specific H720 checkpoint to the exact official fixed-H test loader for each requested horizon.

checkpoint_contract.source: previously completed horizon-specific H720 training artifact
checkpoint_contract.selection: reuse exact immutable H720 checkpoint object and verify SHA256 before and after evaluation

evaluation_contract.loader_construction: For each baseline, dataset and H, reconstruct the official horizon-specific command at H and call that source tree's official test data provider with pred_len=H.
evaluation_contract.test_split: exact source-native fixed-H official test split
evaluation_contract.history_input: the fixed-H loader's historical input only
evaluation_contract.known_decoder_context: source-native label_len history is permitted when required by the official model API
evaluation_contract.prediction: first H steps of the H720 checkpoint output
evaluation_contract.target: the fixed-H loader's H-step test label
evaluation_contract.metric_scope: all evaluated origins, future steps and channels retained by the official loader

source_roles.TimeAlign: official repository and official dataset scripts
source_roles.QDF: official repository and official dataset scripts; locally frozen Solar script derived from the audited ECL form
source_roles.AMD: official repository and official dataset scripts
source_roles.SimpleTM: official repository and official dataset scripts
source_roles.iTransformer: official repository and official dataset scripts
source_roles.PatchTST: official repository and official dataset scripts; Solar uses the previously frozen source-informed loader/profile patch
source_roles.DLinear: official repository and official dataset scripts; Solar uses the previously frozen source-informed loader/profile patch

prelaunch: 63 checkpoint objects exist and have 63 unique frozen SHA256 hashes
252 jobs are present with the exact baseline/dataset/repetition/horizon identity
each expected drop_last value is frozen from the corresponding source data provider
GPU availability and remote quota are recorded before launch
per_evaluation: observed drop_last equals the frozen source-native value
origin_count equals the official loader's retained test origins
complete_matrix: all 196 external aggregate cells and 28 frozen ISCF cells are present
H720 values reproduce the same-checkpoint previous H720 evaluation within numeric tolerance
for each checkpoint, fixed-H origin counts are non-increasing as H grows
gates.paper_replacement: Replace the old Main II table only after every complete-matrix gate passes.

failure_and_rollback.loader_or_runtime_error: patch only the evaluator/loader bridge, preserve checkpoint identity, rerun the failed job and record the correction
failure_and_rollback.drop_last_or_origin_failure: block aggregation and return to source/protocol audit
failure_and_rollback.h720_continuity_failure: block aggregation and identify checkpoint, loader or metric-semantic mismatch
failure_and_rollback.incomplete_matrix: retain the previous Main II as active and do not report partial replacements

disclosure.comparison_role: source-native one-H720-model system comparison, not matched mechanism attribution
disclosure.old_protocol_status: superseded only after this protocol's complete-matrix gate passes
